carlos-letter.summary: manuscript 1873–1889 · printed 1928 · scanned by the family · read here

chain.what: **Carlo De Franceschi writes to Giovanni Kobler from Parenzo.** The letters this page quotes run from **6 February 1873 to 19 June 1889**; the pedigree is from the letter of **10 November 1876** and the retraction from **31 January 1877**.
chain.where: The manuscripts are Kobler's, and went with his papers to Fiume. This archive has not seen them.
chain.gap: **No link exists for this step, and that is the honest state of it.** Everything below rests on somebody else's transcription of these sheets. Kobler's papers are at the Državni arhiv u Rijeci; whether these letters survive in the original has not been checked.

chain.what: **«Lettere di Carlo De Franceschi a Giovanni Kobler», printed 1928.** The letters occupy **pages 107–207** — a hundred pages. This page quotes eight passages from them and the whole of the retraction.
chain.where: Published in the *Atti e memorie della Società istriana di archeologia e storia patria* tradition; not digitised anywhere this archive has found.
links: Atti e memorie, listed at istrianet

chain.what: **The family holds a scan of the printed volume.** That scan is what was read, page by page, and what every Italian quotation on this page was transcribed from.
chain.where: Held with the family's own material, not on a server.

chain.what: **Transcribed, translated and set against the archive's own tree.** The Italian is given first and in full, so the translation can be checked; the note under each says what it changes.
chain.where: Where the letter contradicts what this site said, the contradiction is written up rather than smoothed over — the Valentino retraction is the sharp case.
links: The corrections this archive has published

carlos-letter.caution: **The weak link is the first one.** A printed edition of 1928 is a transcription, and this archive is quoting a scan of it — three removes from Carlo's hand. Nothing on this page has been checked against the manuscript, and until it is, an error in the 1928 typesetting would be invisible here.
